segments.title: Importing from Zen puts pinned tabs in the right profile
segments.body: A Zen profile with two workspaces: Home, and Work in its own container, each with a pin and an Essential. nightly.6 found no spaces and dropped all of it into Personal as tiles; now Home's pins land in Personal and Work's in a Work profile of its own.

segments.title: Onboarding fits a small window
segments.body: All three steps in a 720 × 460 window. nightly.6 cut rows in half and hid the Default browser row; now every row fits, and the last step is one column.

segments.title: Help fix Ardia? stays out of the way
segments.body: A new tab on an install that hasn't answered the sharing question. nightly.6 put the card over the top-left of the page; now it waits in the bottom-left corner, away from the command bar.

segments.title: Settings search shows one result per place
segments.body: Search Settings for "cli". nightly.6 listed the ardia command twice, both leading to the same section; now it's one result.

segments.title: Check Now says Checking… while it checks
segments.body: Mid-check, against a local update feed. nightly.6 left Check Now looking idle; now it reads Checking… with a spinner until the answer comes.
segments.note: stills from the fix's own test

segments.title: A Report a Problem recording shows Picture in Picture
segments.body: The recording a report attaches, pages included, with a video in Picture in Picture over the sidebar. Before the fix it was missing from every frame; now the mini player is drawn where it sits.
segments.note: the recordings made when the fix landed
